overview: Build a minifigure-scale Jedi-like character holding a lightsaber: white outfit with belt, blond hair, and a blue blade. Break into head/hair, torso/arms, legs/stance, and lightsaber accessory.

subassemblies.name: Head + Hair
subassemblies.description: 1 head (skin-tone) with 2 printed eyes/eyebrows and 1 mouth; 1 blond hairpiece swept to the sides (or brick-built hair: 1 top cap + 6–10 curved/cheese slopes layered).

subassemblies.name: Torso + Arms (Robe + Belt)
subassemblies.description: 1 torso core in white with robe folds; 2 arms in white; 2 hands in skin-tone; 1 belt accent at waist (e.g., 1 thin plate/tiles in dark color + 1 small pouch tile/plate).

subassemblies.name: Legs + Feet (White Pants)
subassemblies.description: 2 legs in white; 2 feet blocks; add 2 tan/gold accent lines on each thigh/shin using small tiles/plates (4–8 small detail pieces total) to mimic printed leg patterns; stance slightly offset (one leg forward).

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber (Hilt + Blue Blade)
subassemblies.description: 1 cylindrical hilt (stack of 3–5 round/cylinder-like elements: 1 emitter, 1 grip, 1 pommel); 1 blue blade (1 bar/rod or stacked transparent pieces) extending upward; 2 hands positioned together on the hilt (already counted in torso).
subassemblies.imageRegion: right side, extending from mid-body to top-right
